item.ptxt: Do not disconnect connectors from BCM, battery cable from battery, BCM ground wire harness from body or main fuse before checking diagnostic information (diagnostic trouble codes) stored in BCM memory.

Diagnostic trouble codes stored in BCM can be checked on SUZUKI scan tool. Before checking diagnostic trouble codes, read this manual and Operator's Manual of SUZUKI scan tool to know how to read diagnostic trouble codes.
Read Warning for Air Bag before inspection.
